design: Oracle geometric scalar gains: project true donor-minus-receiver context shifts onto frozen mean shifts per layer or with one shared gain across8 layers. Propagate to compare exact context intervention. Also analytically fit a scalar to the full predicted output effect. All oracle diagnostics use test-target information; no predictive fit.
limitations: Geometric gains optimize context Euclidean error, not final response. Output-effect scalar is not an optimum over8 layer gains. No claim that all functional gain models are exhausted.
